title: Synthesis of stretchable triboelectric material with strain-compensating ability using gradient interpenetrating polymer networks
content:
Energy Environ. Sci., 2025, 18,4080-4096
DOI: 10.1039/D4EE03110E, Paper

Do-Wan Kim, Hyeonwoo Mun, Yeonghun Kang, Weon-Guk Kim, Dahye Ahn, Seong-Yun Yun, Jeong-A Han, Do Hoon Lee, Taegoon Lee, Kihoon Jeong, Jihan Kim, Sung Gap Im, Yang-Kyu Choi
A complementary material synthesis strategy is developed for high-performance stretchable triboelectric materials, achieving a record-high output (267.2 mC m−3) among TENGs that utilize contact electrification between solids.
